import sys

n = int(input().strip())

# Initialize a list to store the array elements
a = [0] * n

# Make n requests to guess the array
for i in range(n):
    if i == 0:
        # Request the sum of the first and last elements
        print("? 1 {}".format(n), flush=True)
        a[i] = int(input().strip())
    else:
        # Request the sum of the current and previous elements
        print("? {} {}".format(i + 1, i), flush=True)
        a[i] = int(input().strip()) - a[i - 1]

# Calculate the remaining elements of the array
for i in range(n - 1):
    a[n - 1] -= a[i]

# Print the guessed array
print("! {}".format(" ".join(map(str, a))), flush=True)
